A.label: the supplier
A.description: Issued the invoice and is owed the disputed balance.

B.label: the customer
B.description: Received the goods or services and disputes part or all of the invoice.

suggestedConditions: customer pays the settled amount within 30 days
supplier issues a corrected final invoice for the settled amount
supplier waives late fees and interest on the disputed balance
both parties keep the existing service agreement unchanged

guidance.consent: This is a commercial disagreement between businesses that expect to keep working together; stay matter-of-fact.
guidance.shuttle: Keep the discussion on the disputed invoice balance and delivery record, not on either company's finances.
